views-of-the-world-types.alt: The same invented island of four districts drawn six ways. A reference map shows where things are: a port, a mill, a river and a road. A choropleth map shades each district by a rate. A dot density map shows counts, one dot each. A graduated symbol map shows amounts by the size of circles. An isoline map joins points of equal value with lines labeled 10, 20 and 30. A cartogram resizes each district by a value.
